color.note: Six themes: dark (default) and light, each with Solid (reduced transparency) and high-contrast versions. The alpha of glass, stage and scrims is this system's transparency design variable. Each text color's usage note states which backgrounds it may sit on; all 701 pairings are verified by calculation (≥ 4.5:1 normal, ≥ 7:1 high contrast).

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background. Floating glass (nav bar, sidebar, toolbar) sits on this color by default.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Opaque content surface: sheets (Modal), cards, forms.

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Inset surface: inputs, text areas, completed notes. Place on surface or glass.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Background of the media stage (video, images, previews). Dark in every theme; always add data-tone="dark" inside the stage.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers, progress-bar tracks, dashed add boxes. Carries no meaning (exempt from 3:1); high-contrast themes raise it to ≥ 3:1.

tokens.name: line-outline
tokens.usage: 1px border for outline buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons. Use on canvas, surface, surface-inset, fill, and glass with a scroll edge (worst case verified ≥ 4.5:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, metadata, unselected tabs. Use on all opaque surfaces and glass (same conditions as ink).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Non-text marks only: arrows, ticks, status dots, decoration other than placeholders. ≥ 3:1, below the 4.5:1 text minimum; never use for text. Light value darkened from the reference's #8f8b9a to reach 3:1.

tokens.name: ink-on-media
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the stage and images (pair with media-glass or media-scrim).

tokens.name: ink-on-media-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the stage. Raised from the reference's 0.62 to keep 4.5:1 on bright frames after the scrim.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Fill for primary actions (Export, Send, Approve), selection outlines, progress. Text on it always uses on-accent. In the light theme the fill is only 2.4:1 against the background, so light selection outlines use accent-text instead.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent (dark text, ≥ 5.9:1 in hover and pressed states).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent-colored text, links, and light-theme selection outlines. Use on all opaque surfaces, fill, accent-soft and glass.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Soft accent background: recommendation callouts, selected rows.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Body-text links; alias of accent-text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Outer keyboard focus ring (2px). ≥ 3:1 against canvas, surface, glass and stage.

tokens.name: focus-inner
tokens.usage: Inner focus-ring gap (2px), keeping the ring visible on images and accent.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Done, approved: status dots and status text. Light value darkened from the reference's #2f8f4e to keep 4.5:1 in the thick-glass worst case.

tokens.name: on-ok
tokens.usage: Text on ok fill (“Approved” badge).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Needs a decision, missing sources: status dots and status text. Light value darkened from the reference's #a86b0c to reach 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-warn
tokens.usage: Text on warn fill (count badges).

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Soft warn background: callouts for questions and missing items.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Text for destructive actions (“Delete” in menus, tinted delete buttons). Dark value lightened from the reference's #e9504d and light value darkened to keep 4.5:1 in the menu-hover worst case.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Fill for confirmed destructive actions (press again to delete). The reference's #e8605b with white text is only 3.4:1, so it is darkened.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger-fill.

tokens.name: media-warn
tokens.usage: Issue markers on the stage (dashed circles, labels).

tokens.name: media-ok
tokens.usage: Done-state text on the stage.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Segmented-control tracks, tinted buttons, group backgrounds, list-row hover (rows inside a group add another fill layer). Can sit inside glass (it is not glass).

tokens.name: fill-strong
tokens.usage: Segmented-control selected thumb, tinted-button hover. Only ink goes on it (ink-muted is only 4.2:1 here in the dark theme). List-row hover uses fill.

tokens.name: fill-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state for tinted and plain buttons.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Regular glass: nav island, tab bar, sidebar, toolbar, composer — on canvas, or with lg-scroll-edge when content scrolls beneath. Menus and toasts over arbitrary content use glass-thick. Opaque in Solid and high-contrast themes.

tokens.name: glass-thick
tokens.usage: Thick glass: glass that covers arbitrary content — menus, popovers, toasts, half-height sheets, sidebars over a background extension. Even over pure white (dark theme) or pure black (light theme), all text including hover states stays ≥ 4.5:1.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px outer edge of glass. White in the light theme, where the glass shadow separates glass from the background. A solid line ≥ 3:1 in high-contrast themes.

tokens.name: media-glass
tokens.usage: Glass on the stage: labels, playback toolbar, floating buttons. Dark in every theme. Only within the full-strength band of media-scrim; captions outside the band use media-plate.

tokens.name: media-plate
tokens.usage: Caption plate on the stage (lg-plate): note captions mid-frame, numbers on media frames. Not glass (no blur), just a translucent backing; white and secondary text stay ≥ 4.5:1 even over a pure white frame.

tokens.name: media-edge
tokens.usage: 1px outer edge of media-glass.

tokens.name: media-fill
tokens.usage: Background for round icon buttons and segmented tracks on the stage.

tokens.name: media-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover for media-fill.

tokens.name: media-scrim-top
tokens.usage: Top scrim band on the stage: full strength for the top 64px, fading out by 140px. Top labels must sit within those 64px. Slightly darker than the reference's 0.4 so it can carry secondary text.

tokens.name: media-scrim-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom scrim band on the stage: full strength for the bottom 88px, fading out by 180px. The playback toolbar must fall within those 88px.

tokens.name: scroll-edge
tokens.usage: Scroll edge: canvas color laid behind glass when content scrolls under floating navigation. This density is the minimum that keeps ink-muted at 4.5:1 on glass.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim behind sheets (Modal).

tokens.name: lightbox
tokens.usage: Background of the full-screen image preview.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", "PingFang TC", "Noto Sans TC", "Microsoft JhengHei", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Titles are always 600 weight with negative tracking (bundle.css resets tracking to zero for CJK titles). display-1 is only for website hero headings; app interfaces start at title-1.

styles.name: display-1
styles.usage: Website hero heading, at most once per page. Below 744px, use display-1-sm.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Page or item title (one character, one project). Unchanged on mobile.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: The interface is based on 14px (body is the html default). 13px is the workhorse size for controls and lists. Text 13px or smaller on glass uses the 600-weight styles.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Subsection headings in the content area.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Subsection headings in panels, current item in the nav bar.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: On an opaque surface, effects never get in the way of reading.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Descriptions, explanatory paragraphs, inputs in sheets.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Glass belongs only to the navigation layer; content always comes first.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: md buttons, segmented controls, nav links, list-row titles.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: List-row body text, toasts, text in the nav bar.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Activity log, captions on media, secondary sentences.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: sm buttons, badges, small segmented controls; with ink-muted, group headers (title-style capitalization, never all caps).

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Smallest badge text (“Recommended”, numbers on thumbnails).

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Numbers, IDs, timecodes and shortcuts are always monospaced.

spacing.note: Named in pixels; the name is the value. 2, 6, 10 and 14 are half steps for capsule insets and compact lists.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between segmented-control items; between a label and its subtitle.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between list rows; minimum gap between icon and text.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Capsule inset (30–32px controls in a 42px capsule), list-row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between buttons, card-grid gaps, mobile nav margins.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between nav islands, panel horizontal padding, gap between stage and sidebar.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between thumbnail and text in list rows, block spacing in sheets.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Panel vertical padding, left text padding in capsules.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (md), card padding, mobile page margins.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Sheet horizontal padding, distance from the desktop nav bar to the window sides.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Content-area horizontal padding (apps).

tokens.name: space-36
tokens.usage: Between the two columns of the content area.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Website pages: mobile section spacing.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Website pages: desktop page margins.

tokens.name: space-96
tokens.usage: Website pages: desktop section spacing, hero vertical whitespace.

radius.note: Concentric rule: when the gap between two nested corners is ≤ 8px, inner radius = outer radius − gap (sidebar 28 inset 6 → group 22; menu 22 inset 6 → item 16). Glass controls are always capsules.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Smallest thumbnails (48 × 30).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: List thumbnails, timeline clips, small blocks inside forms.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: List rows, small media thumbnails, hint boxes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Media frames in the stage, rows in panel groups, menu items, callouts.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Content cards, recommendation callouts, text areas.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers, groups in the sidebar, long toolbars on the stage.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: Stage, panels docked at the bottom.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Sidebar and inspector (GlassPanel).

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets (Modal).

tokens.name: radius-capsule
tokens.usage: Nav islands, buttons, segmented controls, toolbars, composer, badges.

shadow.note: Glass depth = inner specular highlight (a 1px bright top line) + outer elevation-* shadow, combined with a comma. High-contrast themes turn the highlight off.

tokens.name: specular
tokens.usage: Top-edge specular highlight for all glass.

tokens.name: specular-media
tokens.usage: Top-edge highlight for media-glass on the stage (dark glass in every theme).

tokens.name: elevation-glass
tokens.usage: Nav islands, sidebar, toolbar, composer. In the light theme, this violet-tinted shadow separates glass from the background.

tokens.name: elevation-menu
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts.

tokens.name: elevation-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets (Modal).

tokens.name: elevation-media
tokens.usage: Playback toolbar on the stage.

tokens.name: elevation-thumb
tokens.usage: Selected thumb of segmented controls.

tokens.name: elevation-pin
tokens.usage: Markers on the stage, recommendation badges.

blur.note: Restrained blur. Restrained (default) uses blur-glass; websites may offer a Stronger option (data-glass="strong"). Never animate blur.

tokens.name: blur-chip
tokens.usage: Small labels and small round buttons on the stage.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Nav islands, sidebar, toolbar, composer (Restrained).

tokens.name: blur-glass-strong
tokens.usage: blur-glass in Stronger mode.

tokens.name: blur-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts, half-height sheets: they cover other interface elements and need more blur.

tokens.name: blur-extend
tokens.usage: Background extension (lg-extend): blur used when the image beside the sidebar is mirrored to extend beneath it.

glass.note: Glass filter parameters. bundle.js writes refraction-* into an SVG displacement filter; Chromium only.

tokens.name: glass-saturate
tokens.usage: Backdrop saturation boost (Restrained).

tokens.name: glass-saturate-strong
tokens.usage: Saturation in Stronger mode.

tokens.name: refraction-scale
tokens.usage: Refraction displacement (px). Above 20, text distorts noticeably.

tokens.name: refraction-edge
tokens.usage: Width of the refraction edge band (px); the center stays sharp.

border.note: Glass edges, selection outlines and focus rings.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Glass edges, outline buttons.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Glass and control borders in high-contrast themes.

tokens.name: ring-selected
tokens.usage: Outline of a selected media frame (inset 3px).

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Outer focus-ring width.

tokens.name: focus-gap
tokens.usage: Inner focus-ring gap width.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled buttons and controls (colors unchanged; overall opacity reduced).

tokens.name: brightness-hover
tokens.usage: Hover for accent and solid fills (filter: brightness).

tokens.name: brightness-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state for accent and solid fills.

duration.note: With reduced motion, all translation, scaling and morphing is off; only fades ≤ duration-fast remain.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Color, hover, focus, media zoom.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Segmented thumb movement, menu expansion.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Sheet entrance and exit.

tokens.name: duration-progress
tokens.usage: Progress-bar width changes.

easing.note: The gel-like feel comes only from the small overshoot of ease-spring (about 8%), used only for press release and thumb settling.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default: color, fade-in, translation.

tokens.name: ease-emphasized
tokens.usage: Sheets, menu expansion.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Exits.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Bounce on press release, segmented thumb settling.

tokens.name: z-content
tokens.usage: Content layer and stage.

tokens.name: z-panel
tokens.usage: Sidebar and inspector pinned beside content.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Floating nav islands and scroll edge.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Full-screen preview (sheets use the native dialog top layer and don't need this value).

layout.note: Fixed sizes. The 744px and 1100px breakpoints live in CSS container and media queries and cannot use variables.

tokens.name: control-xs
tokens.usage: Small segmented controls and filter chips on the stage.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons in nav islands, compact buttons, close buttons.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons and round icon buttons.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary confirm buttons; minimum size on touch devices.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Composer.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Nav island height.

tokens.name: nav-top
tokens.usage: Nav island offset from the top of the viewport.

tokens.name: nav-side
tokens.usage: Nav island offset from the viewport sides (below 744px, use nav-inset-mobile).

tokens.name: nav-gap
tokens.usage: Between nav islands.

tokens.name: nav-inset-mobile
tokens.usage: Mobile nav island and tab bar offset from the viewport edges (plus safe area).

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Mobile tab bar (< 744px) capsule height; the search button on the right is a circle of the same height.

tokens.name: tabbar-height-min
tokens.usage: Tab bar height after shrinking on scroll down (current tab only).

tokens.name: content-top
tokens.usage: Top margin of the first block below the nav (nav-top + nav-height + 12).

tokens.name: toolbar-height
tokens.usage: Toolbar capsule height (36px controls + 6px inset).

tokens.name: aside-width
tokens.usage: Right inspector width (≥ 1100px).

tokens.name: aside-width-compact
tokens.usage: Right inspector width (744–1099px).

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Left rail width (≥ 1100px).

tokens.name: rail-width-compact
tokens.usage: Left rail width (744–1099px).

tokens.name: composer-max
tokens.usage: Maximum composer width.

tokens.name: menu-width
tokens.usage: Width of menus, the queue and other popovers.

tokens.name: menu-width-sm
tokens.usage: Width of small menus on cards.

tokens.name: sheet-width
tokens.usage: Sheet width.

tokens.name: sheet-width-compact
tokens.usage: Width of a single-question sheet.

tokens.name: layout-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width on website pages.

tokens.name: layout-text
tokens.usage: Long-form text column width.

tokens.name: gutter-mobile
tokens.usage: Page side margins (< 744px).

tokens.name: gutter-desktop
tokens.usage: Side margins on website pages (≥ 1100px).

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target size.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in small buttons and status bars.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icons (16 grid, 1.6px stroke, round caps).

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons in large buttons and empty states.
